card.name: Flying Saucer
card.subject: A round silver flying saucer, perfectly symmetrical, with a smooth clear dome on top, a flat disc rim with a ring of eight yellow lights and three small round feet underneath, flying in a clear sky.
card.hero_colors: silver, grey, pale green dome, small yellow lights

card.name: Ringed Planet
card.subject: A round orange planet with soft cream stripes and one wide flat ring circling its middle at a tilt, the ring symmetrical with a thin pink stripe on it.
card.hero_colors: orange, cream, small pink stripe on the ring

card.name: Satellite
card.subject: A gold box-shaped satellite body with two rectangular blue solar panels fixed on opposite sides by short arms and a small white round dish on top.

card.name: Space Helmet
card.subject: A round white space helmet with a wide curved gold visor and a thick ring collar at the neck, with an orange stripe on the collar and two small hose connectors on its sides.
card.hero_colors: white, gold visor, small orange stripe on the collar

card.name: Glow Flask
card.subject: A conical glass flask with a round body and narrow neck, a tan cork stopper and bright green glowing liquid with three yellow bubbles.
card.hero_colors: green liquid, clear glass, tan cork, small yellow bubbles

card.name: Moon Rover
card.subject: A white six-wheeled rover with a flat boxy body, a small round dish on a short mast fixed on top and a front camera box with a blue lens, standing on grey dust.
card.hero_colors: white, grey, black wheels, small blue lens

card.name: Star Map
card.subject: A round dark blue star chart lying flat, with white dots joined by thin lines and one small orange ringed planet icon.
card.hero_colors: navy blue, white, small orange planet icon

card.name: Rocket
card.subject: A tall white rocket with a pointed red nose cone, two round yellow windows and four red fins at its base, standing upright on a flat concrete launch pad.

card.name: Control Panel
card.subject: A grey rectangular control panel mounted on a wall, with a blue screen showing a planet icon, three rows of round yellow buttons and two sliding levers fixed in slots.
card.hero_colors: grey, blue screen, small yellow buttons

card.name: Space Farm
card.subject: The cow and the rooster wear matching silver space jumpsuits and stand in a grassy field while a small flying saucer hovers above them with a pale light, and the rooster points up with its wing.
card.surface_or_setting: a grassy field under a clear sky
